# foo.iv 2.0.0

**Release type:** foo.iv

**Git tag:** `foo.iv-v2.0.0`

foo.iv adds `.iv` syntax highlighting, file icons, bracket handling, indentation, comment commands, and snippets to VS Code.

## Release Files

| Type | File |
| --- | --- |
| VS Code extension | `foo.iv-2.0.0.vsix` |
| Checksums | `SHA256SUMS.txt` |

Install the VSIX from the Extensions view with **Install from VSIX**.
